notes.title: Update
notes.content: The remake of the game is comming along well.  It should be done by the end of next week or early the following week.  Tuesday I have a QA team coming in to test it out.

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Just released the new update.  This update includes 
- 2 new play modes
- rebuild the last two scenes in story mode to make it easier to follow
- fixed many bug thanks to the cumminity for finding.  
- demo mode created so you can try it before you buy.

The next update this game will be out of early access.  I am planning on this update to happen next week.
